title: "Clone a GitHub repository"
---

## Clone a repository

In this assignment, you will clone your personal assignment repository from GitHub to Posit Cloud.

1. Open github.com in your browser.

![](images/screenshot-github-homepage.png){width=100%}

2. Navigate to the GitHub organisation for the course.

![](images/screenshot-github-org-search.png){width=100%}

3. Find the repository md-01-assignments-USERNAME that ends with your GitHub username, and open it.

![](images/screenshot-github-repo-list.png){width=100%}

4. Click on the green "Code" button.

![](images/screenshot-github-code-button.png){width=100%}

5. Copy the HTTPS URL to your clipboard.

![](images/screenshot-github-https-url.png){width=100%}

6. Open the ds4owd workspace on [posit.cloud](https://posit.cloud/spaces/663318/content/all?sort=name_asc)

![](images/screenshot-posit-cloud-workspace.png){width=100%}

7. Click New Project > New Project from Git Repository

![](images/screenshot-posit-cloud-new-project.png){width=100%}

8. Paste the HTTPS URL from GitHub into the "URL of your Git Repository" field.

![](images/screenshot-posit-cloud-git-url.png){width=100%}

9. Wait until the project is deployed

![](images/screenshot-posit-cloud-deploying.png){width=100%}

10. Continue with the next assignment.
